title: Chimaera: A Mixture-of-Graph-Experts Architecture for Cross-Task and Cross-Dataset Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.08709v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing foundation models for graphs is challenging due to the irregular structure of graphs and the different sizes and characteristics of embeddings. Chimaera integrates mixture-of-experts with graph foundation models (GFM). It integrates different GFM architectures, such as graph prompts and linear GNN models. Large language models are used to generate embeddings, and experts can be trained and combined following different strategies, GFMs, embeddings, etc. Furthermore, Chimaera extends existing linear GNNs to support link-level and graph-level tasks in addition to node-level tasks. Empirical analyses are performed on same-task and cross-task experiments with node, link, and graph classification tasks using six benchmark text-attributed graph datasets. translated_title: Chimaera：一种用于跨任务和跨数据集图学习的图专家混合架构
translated_abstract: 为图设计基础模型具有挑战性，原因在于图结构的不规则性以及嵌入的尺寸和特征各不相同。Chimaera 将专家混合机制与图基础模型（GFM）相结合，整合了不同的 GFM 架构，例如图提示和线性 GNN 模型。该方法利用大语言模型生成嵌入，专家可以按照不同的策略进行训练和组合，包括不同的 GFM、嵌入等。此外，Chimaera 扩展了现有的线性 GNN，使其除了支持节点级任务外，还支持链接级和图级任务。研究使用六个基准文本属性图数据集，在节点、链接和图分类任务上进行了同任务和跨任务的实证分析。实验证明了 Chimaera 的有效性及其跨任务和跨数据集的迁移能力。进一步的见解还包括需要同时使用大型和小型语言模型。
tldr: Chimaera 提出了一种将专家混合机制与图基础模型相结合的新架构，通过整合多种 GFM 架构和大语言模型生成的嵌入，实现了跨任务和跨数据集的图学习能力。
en_tdlr: Chimaera proposes a mixture-of-graph-experts architecture that integrates multiple GFM architectures with LLM-generated embeddings, enabling effective cross-task and cross-dataset graph learning.
